WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE ds.wins IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) AS average_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
), overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS benchmark
  FROM country_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, ob.benchmark
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob
  WHERE ca.average_wins > ob.benchmark
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_value
  FROM first_kept
)
SELECT fk.country,
       fk.average_wins AS average,
       fk.average_wins - fk.benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark,
       fk.average_wins - sm.mean_value AS above_second_mean
FROM first_kept AS fk
CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
WHERE fk.average_wins > sm.mean_value;
